what: Under a large title, the background photo starts as a vertical panel hiding 10.83vw on each side (5.33vw on phones), then while passing the blank space above, the mask opens and it spreads to fill the screen, pulling back from 1.03x to 1x and darkening to .4 opacity to become the base for text rising over it (scrub 1.2)

duration.Scroll: From when the top edge of the pinned element touches the top of the screen until its bottom edge touches it

options.dim: End opacity, default .4 — at 1 it does not darken
options.target: CSS to use when the photo sits outside the attached element
options.phone: Width treated as phone view (px), default 900
options.ease: Curve, default is the GSAP default (power1.out — the original does not specify a curve) · corp-brand none

note: The original keeps the photo panel pinned to the screen until the whole intro content has passed (separate pin, scrub 1). For pinning, the consumer can simply use position: sticky

from.where: about.html top blank .ku-aboutBlank → .ku-aboutBackground__image (same timeline in about.js)

about.html .sub-hero .v4 (wide photo) — the original --mask-progress .5→1 becomes clip-path inset(0 calc((1 − p) × 50%)), trigger is the photo itself, top bottom → top 20%, scrub true, ease none, size and brightness unchanged
from.options: side: 25%; scale: 1; dim: 1; scrub: true; ease: none; start: top bottom; end: top 20%

from.where: index.js big photo gallery (original SectionLargeGallery expander — clip inset(0 36%)→inset(0), power2.inOut, start top bottom · end bottom bottom, scrub, no darkening or zoom) — at 1440 the 36% on each side ≈ 34.8vw
